retrieval_plan.anchor_strategy: Select one credible public-sector budget execution case where an official budget law/appropriation is published alongside an annual or multi-year actual execution report for the same entity, period, currency, and classification. Use that single case as the anchor; then gather its related reconciliation files (budget law or approved budget document, execution/outturn report, and explanatory notes or review findings) so budget and actuals align on entity, period, currency, units, and classification.
coherence_requirements: Approved budget and actual spending must refer to the same governmental or organizational entity and the same fiscal period(s).
Both figures must be expressed in the same currency and units (or clearly convertible with an explicit official rate/scale).
Classification must match: same program/unit/economic classification or a documented mapping between classification schemes.
Coverage must match: same funds, accounts, or agencies included; note any extrabudgetary or excluded items explicitly.
Documents must come from official or authoritative public sources, not descriptive summaries of roles or generic financial definitions.

expected_gaps.reason: Explanations or supporting operational context for spending differences are often internal and may not be published alongside the budget and execution figures.
Audience requirements and decision-support preferences are organization-specific private inputs and are unlikely to be found in public records.

Rules and legal criteria for permissible adjustments or budget transfers may exist publicly, but precise reconciliation thresholds and corrective action authority are often internal or jurisdiction-specific.

Column semantics (whether 'authorities' = approved budget authority and 'expenditures' = actual spending) remain unverified. One focused search can confirm the Public Accounts of Canada accounting basis and the legal meaning of 'authorities' vs 'expenditures' for one named organizational unit (Department of Agriculture and Agri-Food, FY2011), which would firm up nodes i1/i2 and provide authoritative reconciliation criteria useful for i3.
